skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge to build planning and control systems for logistics operations.
Apply knowledge to make decisions during logistics planning and control processes.
Apply knowledge to forecast demand for logistics planning and control.
Apply knowledge to plan sales and operations activities.
Apply knowledge to plan overall production requirements.
Apply knowledge to plan material requirements for production.
Apply knowledge to plan distribution activities.
Apply knowledge to manage inventory levels.
Collaborate effectively within groups on logistics planning projects.
Resolve conflicts that arise during group work.
Analyze basic tasks involved in logistics planning and control.
Understand the responsibilities of planners and controllers in logistics operations.
